chapters.label: Wembley, 1992
chapters.text: Wembley, 1992, the European Cup final. Barcelona against Sampdoria, still nil-nil in extra time. Free kick! Hristo Stoichkov touches it to José Mari Bakero, who stops it... Ronald Koeman strikes it with his right foot. Goal! Barcelona win their first European Cup!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Koeman runs in straight, head over the ball. He hits it hard, through the middle, with his laces.

chapters.label: Into the corner
chapters.text: From behind the goal: it flies through the players rushing out, past the keeper's hand, into the corner! Koeman sprints to the corner flag.

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? Strike through the middle of the ball with your laces, and keep it low and hard.
